Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing the interactive gaming in schools public-private partnership.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the interactive gaming in schools public-privatepartnership; adding a new section to chapter 28A.300 RCW; creating anew section; and providing expiration dates.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The interactive gaming in schools publicprivate partnership isestablished, composed of the following members: (a) Four members of the legislature, with one member from eachcaucus of the house of representatives appointed by the speaker of thehouse of representatives, and one member from each caucus of the senateappointed by the president of the senate; (b) Four experts in the integration of interactive technology orgaming into education, with one expert nominated by each caucus of thehouse of representatives and submitted for appointment by the speakerof the house of representatives, and one expert nominated by eachcaucus of the senate and submitted for appointment by the president ofthe senate; p. 1 SSB 6104 (c) A representative of the department of early learning, appointedby the director of the department of early learning; (d) A representative of the office of the superintendent of publicinstruction, appointed by the superintendent of public instruction. (2) The chair of the partnership shall be selected by the membersof the partnership from among the legislative members. (3) To the extent funds are appropriated or are made available forthis purpose, the partnership may hire a staff person who shall residein the office of the superintendent of public instruction foradministrative purposes. Additional technical and logistical supportmay be provided by the office of the superintendent of publicinstruction, the organizations concerning the partnership, and otherparticipants in the interactive gaming in schools publicprivatepartnership. (4) The members of the partnership shall be appointed by August 1,2014. (5) Legislative members of the partnership shall receive per diemand travel expenses in accordance with RCW 44.04.120. Nonlegislativemembers, except those representing an employer or organization, areentitled to be reimbursed for travel expenses in accordance with RCW43.03.050 and 43.03.060. (6) This section shall be implemented to the extent funds areavailable. (7) This section expires January 1, 2016.

(1) The purpose of the interactive gaming inschools publicprivate partnership is to examine how interactive gamesmay be integrated into primary and secondary education to increasestudent involvement and achievement. (2) In carrying out its task, and to the extent funds areavailable, the interactive gaming in schools publicprivate partnershipshall: (a) Consider how interactive games and advances in technology maybe integrated into Washington's education system from early learningthrough grade twelve, with a focus on improving student engagement andachievement; (b) Develop a proposal for a pilot program that integrates SSB 6104 p. 2 interactive games into the early learning and K12 curriculum inWashington; (c) Submit the pilot program proposal to the legislature byDecember 1, 2015. (3) This section expires January 1, 2016.
